description: Stage 4 (PUBLISH) aggregate Social-Security Metric (ADR-2605302358). Extends com.etzhayyim.liberation.metricReport with social-security framing. AGGREGATE-ONLY, no per-adherent rows (G12 anti-class, ADR-2605301020 §7). All quantities integer-with-implied-units (no float; ADR-2605190900).

adherentsAtStage.description: count of adherents at this stage (aggregate)

newVowsThisQuarter.description: count of new Level-0 vows recorded this quarter (aggregate)

aggregateOnly.description: INVARIANT G12: no per-adherent identity in this report; aggregation enforced structurally

highIncomeBenchmarkRatioPermille.description: vs OECD upper-decile basket, per-mille; →≥1000 at L6 (ADR-2605301020)

valuationMethod.description: method version of imputed valuation (open, Council-attested)
